# Demographic insights for restoring populations

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(popbio)
library(gridExtra)
library(patchwork)
library(ggsci)

# least squares optimization functions for additive and multiplicative approaches

mfnc <- function(mat, x, lam=1, i=1, j=ncol(mat)) {
  mat[i, j] <- x
  (lam - lambda(mat))^2
}

afnc <- function(mat, x, stg=1, lam=1.1) {
  ss <- stable.stage(mat) * 1
  ss[stg] <- ss[stg] + x
  (lam - sum(mat %*% ss))^2
}

mfnc_prop <- function(mat, x, lam=1, i=1, j=ncol(mat), prop=1) {
  mat[i, j] <- x * prop + mat[i, j] * (1 - prop)
  (lam - lambda(mat))^2
}

# Process the population matrices
source("R/tri_haw.R")
source("R/comadre.R")

```

# MATRIX CALCULATIONS

```{r echo=FALSE}
load(file="output/mats.RData") # Load the matrices
params <- read.csv("data/params.csv") # Load the species parameters

# Calculate species stage mid-point sizes in cm^2
params$rec <- params$rec_juv / 2
params$juv <- (params$rec_juv + params$juv_adu) / 2
params$adu <- params$juv_adu + (params$juv_adu - params$juv)

# Create data frames for storing additive and multiplcative data
astore <- data.frame()
mstore <- data.frame()

for (lam in c(1.01, 1.02, 1.05, 1.1)) { # Loop through 1, 2, 5 and 10% population increases
  for (i in names(mats)) { # Loop through the population matrices
    # Load species matrix
    mat <- mats[[i]]
    
    # Some population metrics, note that lambda should be 1
    lambda(mat)
    stable.stage(mat)
    reproductive.value(mat)

    # Assigning from parameters for the population
    area_vec <- params[params$species==i, c("rec", "juv", "adu")]
    growth_form <- params$growth_form[params$species==i]
    region <- params$region[params$species==i]
    
    # Combine GBR and Hawaii, call Pacific
    if (region %in% c("GBR", "Hawaii")) {
      region <- "Pacific"
    }
    
    # Calculate additions for stages (e.g., recruits) required to increase population by X%
    arec <- optimise(f=afnc, interval=c(0, 1), mat=mat, stg=1, lam=lam)$minimum
    ajuv <- optimise(f=afnc, interval=c(0, 1), mat=mat, stg=2, lam=lam)$minimum
    aadu <- optimise(f=afnc, interval=c(0, 1), mat=mat, stg=3, lam=lam)$minimum
    
    aa <- stable.stage(mat) * area_vec # Coral area by stage
    aa_sum <- sum(aa) # Total coral area based on mid point sizes
    
    # TESTS ONLY
    # (nn_rec * area_vec$rec)
    # (nn_juv * area_vec$juv) / aa_sum
    # (nn_adu * area_vec$adu) / aa_sum
    # (nn_rec * area_vec$rec) * aa[1] +
    # (nn_juv * area_vec$juv) * aa[2] +
    # (nn_adu * area_vec$adu) * aa[3]
    # 
    # stable.stage(mat) * area_vec * c(nn_rec, nn_juv, nn_adu)
    
    astore <- rbind(astore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Recruit", nn=1000 * arec, aa=100 * (arec * area_vec$rec) / aa_sum, growth_form=growth_form, region=region))
    astore <- rbind(astore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Juvenile", nn=1000 * ajuv, aa=100 *(ajuv * area_vec$juv) / aa_sum, growth_form=growth_form, region=region))
    astore <- rbind(astore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Adult", nn=1000 * aadu, aa=100 *(aadu * area_vec$adu) / aa_sum, growth_form=growth_form, region=region))
  
    # Elasticity for ground truthing. 
    ele <- elasticity(mat)

    # RECRUITS
    rec_rec_opt <- optimise(f=mfnc, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=lam, i=1, j=1)$minimum
    rec_juv_opt <- optimise(f=mfnc, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=lam, i=2, j=1)$minimum
    rec_adu_opt <- optimise(f=mfnc, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=lam, i=3, j=1)$minimum

    mstore <- rbind(mstore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Recruit survival", stage_type="survive", current=mat[1,1], required=rec_rec_opt, poss=if(rec_rec_opt + sum(mat[c(2, 3),1]) < 1) {TRUE} else {FALSE}, delta=rec_rec_opt / mat[1,1], ele=ele[1,1], growth_form=growth_form, region=region))

    mstore <- rbind(mstore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Recruit to juvenile growth", stage_type="grow", current=mat[2,1], required=rec_juv_opt, poss=if(rec_juv_opt + sum(mat[c(1, 3),1]) < 1) {TRUE} else {FALSE}, delta=rec_juv_opt / mat[2,1], ele=ele[2,1], growth_form=growth_form, region=region)  )

    mstore <- rbind(mstore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Recruit to adult growth", stage_type="grow", current=mat[3,1], required=rec_adu_opt, poss=if(rec_adu_opt + sum(mat[c(1, 2),1]) < 1) {TRUE} else {FALSE}, delta=rec_adu_opt / mat[3,1], ele=ele[3,1], growth_form=growth_form, region=region)  )

    # JUVENILES
    juv_rec_opt <- optimise(f=mfnc, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=lam, i=1, j=2)$minimum
    juv_juv_opt <- optimise(f=mfnc, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=lam, i=2, j=2)$minimum
    juv_adu_opt <- optimise(f=mfnc, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=lam, i=3, j=2)$minimum

    mstore <- rbind(mstore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Juvenile to recruit shrinkage", stage_type="shrink", current=mat[1,2], required=juv_rec_opt, poss=if(juv_rec_opt + sum(mat[c(2, 3),2]) < 1) {TRUE} else {FALSE}, delta=juv_rec_opt / mat[1,2], ele=ele[1,2], growth_form=growth_form, region=region))  
    
    mstore <- rbind(mstore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Juvenile survival", stage_type="survive", current=mat[2,2], required=juv_juv_opt, poss=if(juv_juv_opt + sum(mat[c(1, 3),2]) < 1) {TRUE} else {FALSE}, delta=juv_juv_opt / mat[2,2], ele=ele[2,2], growth_form=growth_form, region=region)  )

    mstore <- rbind(mstore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Juvenile to adult growth", stage_type="grow", current=mat[3,2], required=juv_adu_opt, poss=if(juv_adu_opt + sum(mat[c(1, 2),2]) < 1) {TRUE} else {FALSE}, delta=juv_adu_opt / mat[3,2], ele=ele[3,2], growth_form=growth_form, region=region)  )

    # ADULTS
    adu_rec_opt <- optimise(f=mfnc, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=lam, i=1, j=3)$minimum
    adu_juv_opt <- optimise(f=mfnc, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=lam, i=2, j=3)$minimum
    adu_adu_opt <- optimise(f=mfnc, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=lam, i=3, j=3)$minimum
    
    mstore <- rbind(mstore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Recruitment", current=mat[1,3], stage_type="recruit", required=adu_rec_opt, poss=TRUE, delta=adu_rec_opt / mat[1,3], ele=ele[1,3], growth_form=growth_form, region=region))
  
    mstore <- rbind(mstore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Adult to Juvenile shrinkage", stage_type="shrink", current=mat[2,3], required=adu_juv_opt, poss=if(adu_juv_opt + sum(mat[3,3]) < 1) {TRUE} else {FALSE}, delta=adu_juv_opt / mat[2,3], ele=ele[2,3], growth_form=growth_form, region=region))
  
    mstore <- rbind(mstore, data.frame(species=i, lam=lam, stage="Adult survival", stage_type="survive", current=mat[3,3], required=adu_adu_opt, poss=if(adu_adu_opt + sum(mat[2,3]) < 1) {TRUE} else {FALSE}, delta=adu_adu_opt / mat[3,3], ele=ele[3,3], growth_form=growth_form, region=region)  )
  
  }
}

mstore$delta[mstore$delta == "Inf"] <- NA

mstore$stage <- factor(mstore$stage, levels = rev(c("Recruit survival", "Juvenile survival", "Adult survival", "Recruit to juvenile growth", "Juvenile to adult growth", "Recruit to adult growth", "Juvenile to recruit shrinkage", "Adult to Juvenile shrinkage", "Recruitment")), ordered = TRUE)
mstore$growth_form <- factor(mstore$growth_form, levels = c("Massive", "Digitate", "Corymbose", "Laminar", "Tabular", "Arborescent"), ordered = TRUE)

astore$stage_ord <- factor(astore$stage, levels = c("Recruit", "Juvenile", "Adult"), ordered = TRUE)
astore$growth_form <- factor(astore$growth_form, levels = c("Massive", "Digitate", "Corymbose", "Laminar", "Tabular", "Arborescent"), ordered = TRUE)

mstore_c <- mstore[!(mstore$stage %in% c("Juvenile to recruit shrinkage", "Adult to Juvenile shrinkage")),]
mstore_c$stage_ord <- factor(mstore_c$stage, levels = rev(c("Recruit survival", "Juvenile survival", "Adult survival", "Recruit to juvenile growth", "Juvenile to adult growth", "Recruit to adult growth", "Recruitment")), ordered = TRUE)


write.csv(mstore, "output/mstore.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(astore, "output/astore.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

# Transition matrix summary

```{r echo=FALSE}
ggplot(mstore[mstore$lam==1.05,], aes(y=stage, x=current, fill=stage_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks=c(0.01, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 10, 100), labels=c(0.01, 0.1, 0.2, 0.5, 1, 10, 100), minor_breaks=0) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0.01, 100)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#004D40", "#1E88E5", "#D81B60", "#FFC107")) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.2, alpha=0.2) +
  xlab("Probability \U00A6 Numbers (log10 axis)") +
  ylab("") +
  geom_vline(xintercept=1, color="black", lty=2) + theme_linedraw() + 
  guides(fill="none") + 
  theme(strip.background =element_rect(fill="white"))+
  theme(strip.text = element_text(colour = 'black')) +
  labs(title="λ=1, all species")

ggsave("figs/figure2.png", width = 8, height = 3)
```

```{r}

noaa <- read.csv("data/hawaii/SectorLevel_Population_Estimates_v2.csv")
med <- median(noaa$Adult_Abun[noaa$Adult_Abun > 0])
qq <- quantile(noaa$Adult_Abun[noaa$Adult_Abun > 0])

a1 <- ggplot(data=noaa, aes(x=Adult_Abun)) +
  geom_histogram(fill="grey") +
  xlab("") +
  theme_bw() +
  scale_x_log10(breaks=10^rep(3:9), limits = c(1000, 10^9), minor_breaks=0, labels=function(x) parse(text=paste("10^",round(log10(x), 2)))) +
  ylab("Number of species") +
  scale_y_continuous(minor_breaks=0, breaks=c(0, 100, 200)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = med)) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = qq[2]), linetype = 2) + 
  ggtitle("A. Population abundance estimates")  + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = qq[4]), linetype = 2)

spp <- unique(astore$species)
n <- 10^seq(3, 9, 0.1)
store_out <- data.frame()

for (stage in c("Recruit", "Juvenile", "Adult")) {
  for (sp in spp) {
    temp_nn <- astore$nn[astore$species==sp & astore$lam==1.05 & astore$stage==stage]
    gf <- astore$growth_form[astore$species==sp][1]
    store_out <- rbind(store_out, data.frame(species=sp, gf=gf, stage=stage, n=n, outplants=n*temp_nn/1000))
  }
}

  scale_y_continuous(minor_breaks=0, breaks=c(0, 5, 10), limits=c(0, 10)) +
  scale_x_log10(breaks=10^rep(0:5), limits = c(10, 10^5), minor_breaks=0, labels=function(x) parse(text=paste("10^",round(log10(x), 2)))) +
  ggtitle("D. Population area estimates") + 
  # geom_segment(aes(x = 10, y = 9, xend = 10, yend = 7), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.5, "cm"))) +
  # annotate("text", x=10, y=9.5, label = "20 football\nfields", size=3) +

m1


spp <- unique(mstore$species)
store_prop <- data.frame()

for (sp in spp) {

  eg <- mstore[mstore$species==sp & mstore$lam=="1.05",]

  mat <- matrix(c(eg$current[1], eg$current[4], eg$current[7],
                eg$current[2], eg$current[5], eg$current[8],
                eg$current[3], eg$current[6], eg$current[9]), nrow=3, byrow=TRUE,
                dimnames=list(c("recruit","juvenile","adult"),
                    c("recruit","juvenile","adult")))
  fposs <- 0
  flag <- 0
  
  for (prop in seq(0.01, 1, 0.01)) {
    adult <- optimise(f=mfnc_prop, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=1.05, i=3, j=3, prop=prop)$minimum
    adult_juv <- eg$current[eg$stage=="Adult to Juvenile shrinkage"]
    
    poss <- 1
    if ((adult + adult_juv) > 1) {poss <- 0}
    if (fposs == 0 & poss == 1 & flag==0) {fposs <- 1; flag <- 1}
    
    recruit <- optimise(f=mfnc_prop, interval=c(0, 10000), mat=mat, lam=1.05, i=1, j=3, prop=prop)$minimum
    
    store_prop <- rbind(store_prop, data.frame(species=sp, prop=prop, change_adu=adult / eg$current[9], change_rec=recruit  / eg$current[7], poss=poss, fposs=fposs, tposs=eg$poss[9]))
    fposs <- 0
  }
}

m2 <- ggplot(store_prop[store_prop$poss==1,], aes(x=prop, y=change_adu, color =species)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(data=store_prop[store_prop$fposs==1,], aes(x=prop, y=change_adu)) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks=c(1, 1.1, 1.5, 2, 5, 10, 50), limits = c(1, 6), minor_breaks=0, labels = ~ format(.x, scientific = FALSE)) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option='turbo') +
  xlim(0, 1) + 
  xlab("") +
  ylab("Transition probability change for 5% increase") +
  annotate("text", x=0.8, y=2.6, label = "Porites astreoides", angle=0, fontface = "italic", size=3) +
  # annotate("text", x=0.8, y=2.6, label = "Acropora cervicornis", angle=0, fontface = "italic", size=3) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position="none", panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("E. Adult survival")
m2

store_prop[store_prop$prop==1,]


m3 <- ggplot(store_prop[store_prop$tposs,], aes(x=prop, y=change_rec, color=species)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_y_log10(breaks=c(1, 1.1, 1.5, 2, 5), limits = c(1, 5), minor_breaks=0, labels = ~ format(.x, scientific = FALSE)) +
  scale_colour_viridis_d(option='turbo') +

  theme_bw() +
```
